title: Restore Hugging Face cross-provider model data
description: Correct docs/model-data-apis.md by documenting Hugging Face Hub and Inference Providers as a cross-provider model-data source, including provider mappings, status, task, and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Hugging Face appears in the comparison and has a sourced section accurately describing cross-provider data.

title: Narrow model API catalog to cross-provider sources
description: Revise docs/model-data-apis.md to remove provider-native and repository-only APIs, retaining only APIs that aggregate model data across multiple providers.
acceptance_criteria: The document and comparison table contain only cross-provider model-data APIs and clearly describe their coverage boundaries.

title: Research APIs for model availability data
description: Research authoritative web API sources that expose available AI model catalogs and metadata, explain each field's meaning and limitations, and write a sourced Markdown document under docs without relying on unsupported assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: A Markdown document under docs catalogs relevant APIs, their data fields and semantics, source URLs, authentication/access constraints, and limitations for determining model availability.
close_reason: Created a researched, sourced catalog of model-data APIs with field semantics, availability boundaries, limitations, and an ingestion recommendation.

close_reason: Matched dev/productivity to the referenced plano-client script and verified its weekly report.

title: Add pino JSON file logging
description: Implement the approved plan for pino JSON file logging and update tests

title: Add a real logger instead of console logging everywhere
description: The codebase currently uses console.error/console.log directly in many modules. We should introduce a proper logger abstraction so messages can be routed, formatted, and silenced in tests and production. This issue covers adding the logger, replacing direct console usage, and updating tests so they do not depend on console output.

title: Research openai SDK features vs plain fetch for goal requests
description: requestGoals in src/plan/goals/request.ts uses plain fetch. Research which openai SDK features we lack: retries/backoff, timeout handling, typed errors, streaming. Decide whether to reintroduce the SDK or build what's needed.
